|lore=Bounty hunter. Went berserk upon activation. Murdered all designers at Holowan Mechanicals. IG-88’s outstanding “dismantle on sight” warrant ignored by Darth Vader.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May use two weapons, battle and be battled. While escorting a captive, defense value +2 and once per turn, may take one card from your Force Pile into hand; reshuffle. Immune to Ambush, Wookiee Strangle, Restraining Bolt, purchase, and attrition < ability of highest ability character at same site.

|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[IG-88 (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[IG-88 (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The later slip increases deploy from 2 to 4 and adds Presence. The original separately permits IG-88 to battle and be battled. The later text drops the captive escort defense bonus and four named immunities, adds weapon destiny cancellation for 1 Force, and sets attrition immunity at less than 5. Both keep the inherited Pilot and two Warrior icons, the pilot bonus, two weapons and the captive escort card draw. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=93 Period Presence icon rules].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf Virtual Set #5 first release sheet] (theforce.net, 30 May 2003; Internet Archive 1 August 2003), page 3, slip 40.
* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf Virtual Set #5 revised sheet] (publisher index dates the edition 19 June 2003), res.starwarsccg.org, page 3, slip 40. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114014729/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch2-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf VirtualCards5.pdf] (Remaster sheet, official text as of 4 December 2006; Internet Archive 24 October 2007).
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[IG-88]].

=== Publication sources ===
* '''Source publication''' (this page): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 3, slip 40 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “P 2. May use two weapons, battle and be battled. While escorting a captive, defense value +2 and once per turn, may take one card from your Force Pile into hand; reshuffle. Immune to Ambush, Wookiee Strangle, Restraining Bolt, purchase, and attrition < ability of highest ability character at same site.” Stats line: “POWER 4 ARMOR 5 ASSASSIN DROID”. Deploy 2, forfeit 5. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•40” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; the copy the Players Committee still hosts at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org]) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS5-40-IG_88-original-slip-2003-06-11.png]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114014729/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch2-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].
* '''Source publication''' ([[IG-88 (V) (Virtual Set 5) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 40), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May use two weapons. Once per turn, if escorting a captive, may take any one card from Force Pile into hand; reshuffle. May lose 1 Force to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting IG-88. Immune to attrition < 5.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
|hatnote=This is the original 30 May 2003 printing of [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]] (old pre-Remaster slip). For the current text, see [[IG-88 (V) (Virtual Set 5) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[IG-88]].
|effective=6 June 2003<ref name="date-ovs5-release-20030530" />
